title: Where Shall We Go?

pre.en: Where will they have Mei's birthday dinner?
pre.zh: Mei 的生日饭最后在哪儿吃？

intro: 四个朋友的群聊：给 Mei 过生日，去意大利餐厅还是韩国烤肉？你一言我一语，越聊越乱。这是本单元的复习课：留意怎么提建议、怎么拍板——Shall we、Let's、We could、I'd rather；本单元 1–9 课的语法，从 must、should have 到 If I were、managed to，也都在里面。

sentences.en: OK, Mei's birthday dinner on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 好，周六给 Mei 吃生日饭的事。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: Shall we book the Italian place or the Korean barbecue?
sentences.zh: 我们订那家意大利餐厅，还是那家韩国烤肉？

sentences.en: Korean, definitely!
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I don't feel like eating pasta again.
Both are quite expensive, but we could split the bill three ways.
sentences.zh: 两家都不便宜，不过我们可以三个人平摊。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Mei doesn't have to pay, obviously.
Absolutely.
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: We should book a table tonight.
It'll definitely be busy on a Saturday.
Too late for the Italian place — I've just checked.
sentences.zh: 意大利那家已经来不及了——我刚查过。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: It's fully booked.
In that case, let's go for the barbecue.
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: Let me call them.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: OK, I've managed to get the last table, but it's at half past nine.
sentences.zh: 好了，最后一张桌子被我抢到了，不过是九点半的。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Isn't that a bit late for Mei?
sentences.zh: 对 Mei 来说是不是有点晚？

sentences.en: We should have booked last week!
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I told you we needed to plan ahead.
If I were Mei, I'd want an early dinner.
sentences.zh: 换我是 Mei，我会想早点吃。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: Then why don't we ask her?
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's her birthday, after all.
Mei, it's up to you!
She hates it when people make a fuss about her birthday.
sentences.zh: 她最烦别人为她过生日大张旗鼓了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Let's just make a decision.
Fine.
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: I'll take care of the dessert — she loves chocolate.
sentences.zh: 甜点我来管——她爱吃巧克力。

sentences.en: And I'll invite my cousin.
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: He's single, you know.
You'd better not, Tom.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Stop trying to set Mei up with your cousin.
sentences.zh: 别老想着把你表弟介绍给 Mei。

sentences.en: Mei hasn't said a word for an hour.
sentences.zh: Mei 已经一个小时没吭声了。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: She must be fed up with us.
Or she might have left the group.
sentences.zh: 要不就是她已经退群了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I've read every single message.
sentences.speaker: Mei

sentences.en: And I'd rather cook at home than read fifty more.
sentences.zh: 我宁可在家做饭，也不想再看五十条。

sentences.en: Dumplings, my place, seven o'clock.
Chen, you're only bringing drinks.
Tom told me about the rice.
sentences.zh: 米饭那事儿，Tom 都跟我说了。

cards.note: 也常写成 BBQ；have a barbecue 办一场烧烤。

cards.zh: 想（做某事）；有心情（做某事）
cards.note: to want to do something at a particular moment
to share the cost of a meal or service between several people
cards.tip: 平分成几份用 ways：split it four ways；各付各的也可以说 go Dutch，但现在不太常用。
cards.example: Shall we split the bill, or is it my turn to pay?

cards.note: 放在句末是口语里的「那还用说」；形容词 obvious 明显的。
to arrange to have a table at a restaurant at a particular time
cards.tip: 英式说 book a table，美式常说 make a reservation；订几个人的位用 for：book a table for four。
cards.example: I've booked a table for six at eight o'clock.

cards.note: 餐厅、酒店、航班都能说；也可以说 There are no tables left.
used to say what you will do because of the situation that has just been described

cards.tip: 在几个选项里挑一个时常用，比 choose 口语；点菜时也说 I'll go for the fish。
cards.example: I'll go for the vegetarian option, please.

cards.note: to make plans for something before it happens
cards.tip: ahead 本身就是「提前」，后面不用再加 before。
cards.example: If you plan ahead, release week is much calmer.

cards.note: 放在句末，补一个大家都知道的理由；放在句首或句中还有「终究、到头来」的意思：He came after all.（他最后还是来了）
used to say that someone else should make the decision
cards.tip: you 可以换成别人：It's up to her、It's up to the team；不说 It's up to your decision。
cards.example: We can meet online or in the office — it's up to you.

cards.note: to get too excited or worried about something, often in a noisy way
cards.tip: 第 15 课是全家为一场误会闹成一团；这里 about 后面接被人折腾的那件事。
cards.example: It's only a small cut — please don't make a fuss.

cards.note: to choose what to do after thinking about it
cards.tip: 中文说「做决定」，英文用 make，不用 do；也可以只用一个动词 decide。
cards.example: We have to make a decision about the new design by Friday.

cards.note: to look after someone or something
也有「单个的」「单程的」意思：a single room 单人间，a single ticket 单程票。
to arrange for two people to meet because you hope they will start a romantic relationship
to be annoyed or bored with something that has gone on for too long
cards.tip: 第 16 课学过；前面加上 must，就成了第 11 课的推测：「她肯定被我们烦死了」。
cards.example: I'm fed up with this slow laptop.

cards.note: used to say what you would prefer to do
cards.tip: 'd rather 后面接动词原形，than 后面也是动词原形：I'd rather stay than go，不说 I'd rather to stay。
cards.example: I'd rather work late tonight than come in on Saturday.

cards.note: dumpling 泛指各种面皮包馅的点心；包饺子是 make dumplings。
